## 📚 Course Overview

Git and github in a nutshell:
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Directory] --> B(Stage)
  B --> C{Repository }
  C --> D[Remote or github]
  
```



Commands (`git ...`): 
which command works where?
```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant Directory
  participant Stage
  participant Repository
  Note left of Directory: git init
  Directory->>Stage: git add
  Stage->>Repository: git commit
  Repository->>Remote: git push

```

----

If you **change** anything at remote (github) then `pull`(fetch) changes at every level and repeat the cycle:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Directory] --> B(Stage)
  B --> C{Repository }
  C --> D[Remote or github]
  D --> A[Directory]
```


```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant Directory
  participant Stage
  participant Repository
  participant Remote
  Note left of Directory: git init
  Note right of Directory: git status <br/>git branch <br/>git checkout
  Directory->>Stage: git add
  Stage->>Repository: git commit
  Repository->>Remote: git push
  Remote->>Directory: git pull
```
  
----

If you are **a team** of two people, you may like to work independently and then merge all:
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[Directory] --> B(Stage 1)
  A[Directory] --> C(Stage 2)
  B --> D{Repository 1}
  C --> E{Repository 2}
  D --> F[Merge repository]
  E --> F[Merge repository]
  F --> G[Remote or Github]
  G --> A[Directory]
```

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant Directory
  participant Stage
  participant Repository
  participant Remote

  Directory->>Directory: git init
  loop check changes
    Directory->>Directory: git status
  end
  
  loop check branches
    Directory->>Directory: git branch 
  end
  
  loop create branches
    Directory->>Directory: git checkout -b new_branch 
  end
  
  Directory->>Stage: git add
  Stage->>Repository: git commit
  Directory->>Directory: git checkout main
  Repository->>Repository: git merge new_branch
  Repository->>Remote: git push
  Remote-->>Directory: git pull
```

----

If you like to **download** your latest remote(github) repo to somewhere in your computer


```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  A[Remote or github] --> |git clone| B[New repository]

```
